newsitem.title: BRAZIL: At least 10 dead, 35 injured in Brazil road crash.
newsitem.headline: At least 10 dead, 35 injured in Brazil road crash.

text.p: At least 10 people died and 35 were injured, many seriously, in an early morning crash involving two buses and a truck near the Brazilian town of Juquia, Sao Paulo state, highway police said on Wednesday.

"From what we understand, 10 people died immediately. Most of the 35 injured are in a serious condition and some of the injured are believed to have died on the way to hospital," a highway police official said.
Juquia is around 100 miles (160 kms) south-west of Sao Paulo city.
The official did not have any immediate details of how the accident happened.
